translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15). 'trained_threshold' / 'calibrated_quantile' placeholders become parameter grids chosen on the discovery segment only. Method entries (336-340) are executed as discovery methods of research-matrix, not as single rules.

strategies.name: First-Half-Hour to Close Momentum
assumptions: signal at the bar ending 09:45; held to the session close (intraday lanes force a flat close); calibrated_quantile -> grid chosen on discovery

strategies.name: Opening Gap Exhaustion
strategies.entry: session_open / prev_day_close - 1 > $g and minute_of_session == 15 and close < session_open and close < vwap

blocked.reason: needs historical pre-open indicative buy/sell quantities
blocked.proposed_data: NSE pre-open market data snapshots (09:00-09:08) per session

strategies.name: Market-Neutral Residual Reversal
strategies.entry: zscore(sum(ret - beta(ret, bench(ret), 120)[1] * bench(ret), 5), 60) < -2 and zscore(sum(ret - beta(ret, bench(ret), 120)[1] * bench(ret), 5), 60) > zscore(sum(ret - beta(ret, bench(ret), 120)[1] * bench(ret), 5), 60)[1]
assumptions: benchmark expressions currently resolve to the configured benchmark symbol; must be repointed to an official index series before activation

blocked.reason: DEFERRED by owner priority change 2026-11-15 ('stocks first'): index-relative rule. ETF prices must not substitute for index data, so it is not executed until official index history is registered. The executable definition is preserved unchanged in this entry.
blocked.proposed_data: official NSE index history (Nifty 50 / Nifty Bank / Nifty IT) registered with a checksum manifest; then remove this 'blocked' block

strategies.name: Sector-Neutral Reversal (Banks)
strategies.entry: zscore(ret - beta(ret, ref_symbol("BANKBEES", ret), 120)[1] * ref_symbol("BANKBEES", ret), 20) < -2 and (ret - beta(ret, ref_symbol("BANKBEES", ret), 120)[1] * ref_symbol("BANKBEES", ret)) > (ret - beta(ret, ref_symbol("BANKBEES", ret), 120)[1] * ref_symbol("BANKBEES", ret))[1]
assumptions: benchmark expressions currently resolve to the configured benchmark symbol; must be repointed to an official index series before activation

strategies.name: Liquidity-Shock Reversal
strategies.entry: percentrank(abs(ret) / (close * volume), 250)[1] > 0.95 and ret[1] < -$q and close > close[1]
assumptions: RupeeTurnover approximated by close x volume; the shock bar is t-1 and the confirming higher close is t

strategies.name: Change-Point Breakout
assumptions: Bayesian online change-point posterior replaced by a one-sided CUSUM of standardised returns (mean/sd from the prior 60 bars)

strategies.name: Volatility-Conditioned Momentum
assumptions: the 'successful volatility band' is chosen on the discovery segment as an annualised-HV band [lo, lo+0.15]

strategies.name: Adaptive Mean-Reversion Window
strategies.entry: zscore(close - sma(close, $n), $n) < -$z and zscore(close - sma(close, $n), $n) > zscore(close - sma(close, $n), $n)[1]
assumptions: the half-life-driven window is replaced by a window N chosen on the discovery segment (static, not rolling, adaptation)

strategies.name: Overnight vs Intraday Volatility Imbalance
strategies.entry: (stdev(log(open / close[1]), 20) * stdev(log(open / close[1]), 20)) / (stdev(log(close / open), 20) * stdev(log(close / open), 20)) > $q and close > sma(close, 50)
assumptions: directional condition chosen as close > SMA50 (unspecified in the catalogue)

strategies.name: Downside Volatility Expansion (short)
strategies.entry: (sum(iff(ret < 0, ret * ret, 0), 10) / 10) / (sum(iff(ret < 0, ret * ret, 0), 60) / 60) > $q and close < sma(close, 20)
assumptions: the catalogue frames this as an exit/exposure-reduction rule; tested as a synthetic short when trend confirmation fails (close < SMA20)

strategies.name: Volatility-Targeted Momentum
assumptions: position sizing is NOT modelled: the engine trades equal notional per signal, so the volatility-target weight is ignored
